chapters.title: VI · THE WHITE ROOM

shots.name: S01 God's-eye: from nothing
shots.move: locked-off god's-eye straight down on the gift's shelf; imperceptible vertical descent 17.0 -> 15.6 m with lens creep 28 -> 24.5 deg (48 -> 54 mm); screen-top = -Z, so the gold spine runs exactly vertical through frame centre
shots.notes: Absolute black, the main title, card I; then the gift's eight swatches ignite in mirrored pairs under their own pin lights, transparency 1 -> 0, so the shelf appears as a symmetric diagram threaded on the gold spine: materials, literally, from nothing.
shots.light: 0-6.9 total black (every light 0, star dome 0, every swatch transparency 1). Mirrored pairs ignite over 0.6 s each (PhysicalMaterial.transparency 1->0 and the pair's pin SpotLights 0->1.6): 6.9 gold_leaf + maroon_silk (outer front), 7.5 carrara_marble + orange_velvet (inner front), 8.1 hokie_stone + giftwrap_maroon (outer back), 8.7 giftwrap_cream + brushed_brass (inner back). 9.4-10.0 Key 0->30; 9.8-10.4 Fill 0->7 and Rim 0->26; 10.0-11.0 star dome emissive 0->0.32; the spine catches the Key at 10.2.
shots.post: deep focus f/11; bloom threshold high so only the pins and gold glow; volumetric cones under the 8 pins at low density (shafts of light appearing from nothing); grain 0.035.
shots.kubrick_ref: black overture; god's-eye isolation of a symmetric tableau

shots.name: S02 The crane: god's-eye to elevation
shots.move: one continuous crane arc about the shelf centre (0,1.05,0): from straight overhead the camera sinks through a quarter circle (radius 14.55 -> 11.0 m, smootherstep) to the front elevation at swatch height, pitch -90 -> 0 deg, roll 0, with a reverse zoom 24.5 -> 42 deg; it arrives already creeping forward at 0.7 m/s
shots.notes: The diagram becomes architecture without a cut: the shelf rotates up into a one-point elevation and the central gap between carrara_marble and orange_velvet opens onto the dark hall.
shots.light: Shelf fully lit; stars 0.32; the hall beyond still dark.
shots.post: DOF f/8 on the shelf; the star dome comes up behind as soft bokeh as the horizon enters frame.
shots.kubrick_ref: slow crane from an overhead into a one-point frame

shots.name: S03 The relentless dolly
shots.move: symmetric dolly-in along x=0 at swatch height 1.05 m, constant 0.70 m/s, level, lens creep 42 -> 32 deg (31 -> 41 mm); the vanishing point sits dead centre inside the gift's 0.76 m central gap
shots.dof_target: the inner swatches (carrara_marble, orange_velvet), racking from 10.9 m to 7.0 m
shots.notes: Through the gap the hall lights cascade away in mirrored pairs, the gate catches, and last of all the oculus finds the monolith: a tiny black slab exactly at the vanishing point, 135 m away, between carrara and velvet.
shots.light: 15.8-19.0 hall pilot discs cascade pair by pair, receding (k0..k12, one pair every 0.25 s); 19.1 both half-hall spot groups 0->40; 19.6 gate uplights; 20.1 oculus on the monolith.
shots.post: DOF f/2.8 racking 10.9 -> 7.0 m on the inner swatches, the hall falling soft; volumetric god-rays down the hall as the cascade arrives; horizontal anamorphic streak on the gold architrave.
shots.kubrick_ref: relentless constant-speed dolly with zoom creep; the destination visible at the vanishing point from the first frame

shots.name: S04 FPV: thread the eight
shots.move: FPV gap thread. Punch from 0.7 to 4.6 m/s straight down x=0; thread the 0.76 m gap between carrara_marble and orange_velvet at 1.02 m (0.45 m clear), skim the back step (0.21 m clear) between the turning hokie_stone/cream/brass boxes (0.29 m worst case), dive 15 deg off the back edge to 12 cm over the gold-leaf spine at 6.5 m/s (0.115 m above the leaf), through the hall portal at 24.4 s, pull up to 0.40 m and brake hard (0.5 g) to a dead stop at (0,0.40,-16.7) by 26.2; level and centred, held to 27.5. Lens 32 -> 70 -> 67.4 deg (18 mm).
shots.notes: Stanley takes the sticks: stillness breaks into flight inside the shot, the gift itself is the first gate, and the move ends on the lowest, purest one-point frame of the hall.
shots.light: Shelf and hall unchanged. DroneLamp 0->3 (radius 4) over 20.6-21.0, raking the gold-leaf spine at grazing incidence during the skim 23.6-25.0; back to 0 by 26.5.
shots.post: motion blur, CA 0 -> 0.8 px with speed, FPV barrel distortion 0.03 at fov > 60; specular bloom on the gold spine during the 0.115 m skim; 60k GPU-compute dust motes in the portal light, kicked into a wake by the pass.
shots.kubrick_ref: stillness broken by a single violent move, then stillness again

shots.name: S05 Tricycle-height glide
shots.move: card II fades through black over the still camera; then a low Steadicam glide at 0.40 m on the axis over the hex-carpet runner: 1.2 s ease-in to a constant 1.9 m/s, level, one-point, 18 mm (67.4 deg)
shots.notes: The purest one-point corridor of the film: the hex carpet and its two gold edges converging, plinth pairs and their thirteen new materials sliding past in perfect mirror, one travelling highlight dragged down the brass caps ahead of us.
shots.light: Hall at full. SweepSpot travels (0,9.4,-20) -> (0,9.4,-92) over 29.7-46.7 (4.2 m/s, beamWidth 0.25, cutOffAngle 0.42) dragging a specular highlight over caps and swatches; ceiling strips breathe +-5% at 0.2 Hz; every 4 s a quarter-turn rotation wave runs down the plinth pairs toward the camera (13 OrientationInterpolators, 0.25 s per pair).
shots.post: DOF f/4 at 6 m; motes drifting through the six hall spot cones; the SweepSpot highlight blooms (0.9) as it crosses each brass cap.
shots.kubrick_ref: low tricycle-height glide down a patterned symmetric corridor

shots.name: S06 FPV: slalom of the plinths
shots.move: FPV banked slalom. Breaks left off the spine, climbs to 0.9 m and weaves the left row at 6 m/s: outside k4 (x -4.2), inside k5 (-2.2), outside k6, inside k7, outside k8, crossing the row line every 3 m; roll from lateral acceleration peaks at +-49 deg, roll rate 164 deg/s, 1.7 g felt. After k8 it rolls out toward the spine, punches to 10.4 m/s, climbs to 3.5 m and brakes to a dead stop on the axis at (0,3.5,-88). Min clearance to any plinth, cap or turning swatch 0.64 m. Lens 67 -> 72 deg, then zooms in to 46 deg as it stops.
shots.notes: The composed corridor is broken by flight, then snapped back to a level, centred frame looking through the gate.
shots.light: Hall full; DroneLamp 2.5 (radius 3) flashes each swatch it passes (maroon_lacquer, gold_mosaic_tesserae, bronze_patina, travertine_cream, engraved_brass_guilloche); hall spots dim to 70% over 45.0-46.7 to push the eye through the gate.
shots.post: motion blur; CA up to 1.2 px at max bank; barrel 0.04; motes streak; bloom on the honey_onyx and solar_granulation pairs ahead.
shots.kubrick_ref: the symmetric corridor broken by flight, resolved back to the axis

shots.name: S07 The gate: frame within the frame
shots.move: dead-still at the gate's mid-height (3.5 m), 18 m short of the trilithon; slow lens creep 46 -> 43 deg that continues under the card
shots.dof_target: the gate (the slab 36 m away falls slightly soft)
shots.notes: Frame within the frame: the hall's open end, the gold trilithon centred, and the black slab small and exact at the vanishing point inside it.
shots.light: Monolith lit by the oculus alone; octagon dark; hall at 70%.
shots.post: DOF f/5.6 at 18 m (the slab 36 m away slightly soft); volumetric beams; anamorphic streak on the trilithon's gold edges; grain.
shots.kubrick_ref: centred doorway as a frame within the frame; slow zoom-in on a held composition

shots.name: S08 The gate, held
shots.move: card III fades through black and back up on the same frame; the lens creep continues to 38 deg (35 mm); held level
shots.notes: The held breath before the most aggressive move in the film.
shots.light: Gate uplights to full at 51.2 as the picture returns; stars 0.32.
shots.post: DOF f/5.6 at 18 m (the slab 36 m away slightly soft); volumetric beams; anamorphic streak on the trilithon's gold edges; grain.
shots.kubrick_ref: the held composition, extended past comfort

shots.name: S09 FPV: power loop through the gate
shots.move: FPV punch from rest (0.5 g) down to 3.0 m and through the gate at 8 m/s, then a full 360 deg power loop on the vertical circle centre (0,7.6,-106), radius 4.6 m, constant 8 m/s (2.6 g felt at the bottom; inverted at the top with 0.4 g toward the loop centre): up the far side, inverted 4.2 m over the lintel, down the near side, through the gate a second time (59.36 s) and on up the far side into a vertical climb. Camera uptilt 15 deg toward the loop centre. Gate posts 2.0 m clear.
shots.notes: Rotates the whole world through 360 deg around the trilithon and comes out still on the axis, already climbing.
shots.light: Gate uplights full; DroneLamp 2 (radius 4) flares the gold lintel as it passes overhead; the stars wheel through the frame while inverted.
shots.post: motion blur, CA 1 px, FPV barrel; stars streak below the horizon while inverted; bloom on the gold lintel overhead.
shots.kubrick_ref: the inverted horizon as a disorienting reveal, resolved back into symmetry

shots.name: S10 FPV: ascension to the god's-eye
shots.move: FPV vertical punch-out: the loop opens into a climb straight up at up to 21 m/s with the camera looking into the orrery (the gold sun and the hokie planet cross the frame at 61.0), then a forward nose-over through the horizon, target-locked on the slab, to straight down; dead stop 64 m above the monolith at 64.0. Lens 74 -> 36 deg.
shots.notes: Rise to God's position: the stars, then the clockwork, then the slab exactly on the centre line.
shots.light: Octagon uplight rings ignite clockwise from 12 o'clock, 61.0-62.75 (one every 0.25 s); oculus full.
shots.post: vertical motion blur; height fog (exponential 0.004) so the octagon and rings resolve out of haze as the camera rises; the sun blooms as it crosses the frame at 61.0.
shots.kubrick_ref: vertical ascension resolving into a god's-eye overhead

shots.name: S11 God's-eye: the clockwork
shots.move: dead-still god's-eye 64 m above the monolith, screen-top = -Z; lens creep 36 -> 30.5 deg
shots.notes: Perfect overhead symmetry: the black bar of the slab, the octagon of the gift's eight materials on antique-mirror plinths, guilloche orbit rings, the gold causeway. One motion: the carrara moon and its orange-velvet twin drift across the frame in exact point symmetry (NDC +-0.44,+-0.54 -> +-0.41,+-0.86).
shots.light: Syzygy DirectionalLight 0.2 rakes the rings; octagon at full; DroneLamp 0.
shots.post: deep focus; TAA critical for the 0.12 m guilloche rings at 64 m; bloom on the uplight rings; the moons' terminators softened by the Syzygy light; grain only.
shots.kubrick_ref: god's-eye overhead with a single moving element inside a symmetric frame

shots.name: S12 God's-eye, held through the card
shots.move: card IV fades through black and back up on the same overhead; the creep continues to 28 deg
shots.notes: Back to the overhead, so the dive starts from stillness; the twin moons are leaving the frame.
shots.light: Unchanged.
shots.post: deep focus; TAA critical for the 0.12 m guilloche rings at 64 m; bloom on the uplight rings; the moons' terminators softened by the Syzygy light; grain only.
shots.kubrick_ref: the held overhead

shots.name: S13 FPV: the dive
shots.move: FPV dive target-locked on the monolith's centre: drops 64 m at up to 25.6 m/s, 2.5 m off the slab's face, flares hard at 5 m (3.8 g pull-out), sweeps out to the slab's foot and settles at 0.40 m, level, looking at the face. Camera pitch -90 -> 0 deg continuously (no flip). Lens 28 -> 74 -> 60 deg.
shots.notes: The descent mirrors the ascension and lands level, centred and low at the foot of the slab, black filling the frame.
shots.light: The oculus sheen slides down the polished obsidian as the drone passes; DroneLamp 3 (radius 5) during the flare 76.0-77.6.
shots.post: motion blur, CA 1.2 px at 25 m/s; at the flare 20k compute dust particles lift off the polished floor; SSR of the oculus beam in the obsidian.
shots.kubrick_ref: descent along the monolith's face to a worm's-eye

shots.name: S14 Alignment
shots.move: locked at the slab's foot (0,0.40,-118): level for 1 s, then a smootherstep tilt-up 0 -> 50.5 deg over 78.9-84.9 with lens creep 60 -> 40 deg (21 -> 33 mm); holds through the syzygy at 85.5; creeps to 38.6 deg
shots.dof_target: slab edge and the stack both sharp
shots.notes: From the right, moon (elevation 42.0 deg), planet (51.0) and sun (61.0) slide onto the centre line and nest into a vertical stack just above the slab's top edge (35.5 deg), each body occulting the next one's lower limb; exact at 85.5 s (NDC y -0.41 / +0.03 / +0.51, slab top -0.74).
shots.light: 81.5-85.5 Syzygy DirectionalLight 0.2 -> 1.2 from the sun (direction 0 -0.875 0.485), backlighting moon and planet into crescents; sun emissive 0.35 -> 1.0 peaking at 85.5; oculus 1.0 -> 0.4 so the stack reads; 87.0-88.0 Syzygy back to 0.2.
shots.post: DOF f/8 deep (slab edge and stack sharp); sun bloom plus procedural lens ghosts strictly on the vertical centre line (symmetric because the sun is on axis); volumetric shafts past the moon's rim; exposure +0.3 EV at the 85.5 peak.
shots.kubrick_ref: planetary conjunction stacked on the centre line above the slab, from a worm's-eye

shots.name: S15 FPV: the carve round the slab
shots.move: FPV: the nose drops out of the alignment, punch forward, banked S-carve left round the slab's edge at 7.9 m/s with 0.69 m between lens and obsidian (roll -31 then +27 deg), back onto the axis, climb to 3.0 m, through the hammered-copper door at z -148, hard brake to a dead stop centred in the corridor mouth (0,3,-152) at 93.3, held to 93.8. Lens 38.6 -> 72 -> 46 deg.
shots.notes: A knife-edge pass past the slab and into the dark threshold of the corridor.
shots.light: DroneLamp 2 (radius 4) streaks across the obsidian edge at 88.6; corridor still dark.
shots.post: motion blur; CA 1.5 px through the knife-edge pass; SSR streak of the DroneLamp across the obsidian at 88.6.
shots.kubrick_ref: the composed tableau broken by flight, resolved on a new one-point corridor

shots.name: S16 Threshold
shots.move: card V fades through black over the still camera; then a held one-point frame dead centre in the 6 x 6 m tube; lens creep 46 -> 42 deg
shots.notes: Silence before speed: the light planes ignite in a wave racing to the vanishing point.
shots.light: 96.1 ignition wave: 10 segments front to back, one every 0.1 s; the DroneLamp becomes the courier (radius 12) in the corridor colour.
shots.post: heavy bloom; corridor haze (volumetric 0.01) catching the ignition wave.
shots.kubrick_ref: static threshold of the slit-scan corridor

shots.name: S17 FPV: slit-scan run
shots.move: FPV straight run on the exact axis: 0 -> 12 m/s by 99.5, -> 46 m/s by 104.0, held to 108.5; one smoothstep 360 deg barrel roll over 103.2-108.2 at peak speed (design peak 108 deg/s, 117 deg/s on the rebuild; keys 0.5 s apart, at most 54 deg between keys); decelerates to 14 m/s by 111.5. Lens 42 -> 80 -> 64 deg.
shots.notes: The climax: four planes of moving light pour into one point, and the roll turns the whole corridor around the vanishing point.
shots.light: Segment colours drift ember -> gold -> maroon -> cream along the run, brightest during the roll; the courier DroneLamp tracks the camera and lights the gold spine.
shots.post: slit-scan stack: radial zoom blur about the vanishing point scaled with speed (0 -> 0.35), bloom x2, CA 2 px at peak, 100k compute light particles streaming past, grain 0.04; the barrel roll is applied before post so the streaks stay radial; TAA stable through the roll.
shots.kubrick_ref: slit-scan light planes converging on a single vanishing point

shots.name: S18 FPV: brake into the white
shots.move: FPV hard braking 14 -> 0 m/s (0.5 g) while pedestalling down 3.0 -> 1.55 m, level; crosses the aperture at z -612 at 113.06 s at 6.5 m/s; dead stop on the axis at (0,1.55,-615.5) at 114.5, held to 115.5. Lens 64 -> 50 deg.
shots.notes: From maximum speed to absolute stillness through a whiteout.
shots.light: White room at full from 111.5; corridor segments fade 112.5-113.5; whiteout in post 112.6-114.2.
shots.post: exposure ramp to +3 EV (whiteout) 112.6-114.2, back to 0 by 115.5; bloom threshold drops to 0.6; corridor blur decays to 0.
shots.kubrick_ref: overexposure transition into a white room

shots.name: S19 The white room
shots.move: card VI fades through black over the still camera; then a relentless dolly-in on the axis at eye level (0.8 s ease-in, then 0.30 m/s); lens creep 50 -> 38 deg
shots.dof_target: the reprised shelf (the monolith beyond falls soft)
shots.notes: The glowing floor converges on the original shelf, returned by USE, with the black slab beyond, all on one centre line.
shots.light: Floor glow 1.0; four ceiling spots 0.8; the shelf's own Key/Fill/Rim and pins on (they live inside DEF Shelf); the swatches still turn.
shots.post: DOF f/2.8 at 10 m on the shelf (the monolith soft); soft bloom from the glowing floor (emissive 1.4); SSR reflections of the floor grid in the gold and brass swatches; grain 0.02.
shots.kubrick_ref: neoclassical white room with a glowing floor; centred dolly

shots.name: S20 FPV: the last kiss of gold
shots.move: FPV proximity orbit: dips and banks left, target-locked on the gold_leaf sphere (-2.4,0.72,-624.45); crosses its face 0.29 m off the leaf at 1.5 m/s; arcs out left round the end of the shelf while the lock slides onto the gift's optical axis; swings back in from the left and lands with a yaw-in and a zoom snap (66 -> 35.52 deg) exactly on the gift's own Viewpoint at 129.0.
shots.dof_target: the gold leaf at 0.73 m, racking to 6.4 m on the landing
shots.notes: A last macro of the first material from nothing, gold leaf filling the frame, before the tableau.
shots.light: DroneLamp 1.5 (radius 2) rakes the gold flakes at 0.3 m; off by 128.5.
shots.post: macro DOF f/2 at 0.75 m on the gold during the skim, racking to 6.4 m on the landing; motion blur; subtle CA; sparkle bloom on the gold-leaf flakes.
shots.kubrick_ref: an insert close-up before the closing tableau

shots.name: S21 The first frame, held
shots.move: absolute lock-off on the gift's own Viewpoint 'Shelf' moved to the white room: position (0,2,-618), orientation 1 0 0 -0.2, fieldOfView 0.62 rad (35.52 deg); no movement, no creep
shots.notes: The shelf exactly as the gift first showed it, the glowing floor converging behind, and the monolith standing in the shelf's central gap (NDC y 0.42-0.91, x +-0.06, right above the inner back boxes). The materials return to nothing; black; the end card.
shots.light: 129.0-132.4 lit and still. 132.4-134.8 the materials return to nothing in reverse order, each pair with its pins (transparency 0->1): inner back pair, outer back pair, inner front pair, then gold_leaf + maroon_silk last. 134.8-135.2 floor glow, room spots, Key/Fill/Rim and the monolith to 0. Black from 135.2; end card 135.4-138.0.
shots.post: lock-off, no motion blur; DOF f/5.6 at 6.4 m; grain 0.03; vignette 0.4; bloom and floor glow fade with the materials (132.4-135.2); clean black under the end card.
shots.kubrick_ref: the final held frame; the opening ignition reversed

x3d.fov_convention: X3D fieldOfView = angle of the smaller viewport dimension; fieldOfView = 2 atan(12 / lens_mm) (24 mm gate height); fov_deg in plan/shotlist.json is that angle
